facts.fact: The document states the second national statistics strategy, SNDS 2014-2019, was adopted by the Conseil national de la statistique on 12 May 2016.
A joint mid-term evaluation mission (AFRISTAT, PARIS21, INSEE) of SNDS 2014-2019 was held 20-24 November 2017 and found 52% physical implementation after four of six years.

The final report of the third strategy, SNDS III 2019-2023, was presented to the steering committee on 18 December and to the CTPS on 19 December 2019 after its action plans were validated by the CTPS on 4-5 December, and delivered to ANSD on 23 December 2019.
